description: This file contains unit tests for the TensorFlow Java API class org.tensorflow.Graph. It verifies various functionalities such as graph definition round-trip, operation iteration, gradient computation, and control flow constructs like while loops within the TensorFlow graph.

classes.name: GraphTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing functionalities of org.tensorflow.Graph.

methods.name: graphDefRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests the serialization and deserialization of a TensorFlow graph definition.

methods.name: iterateOverOperations
methods.description: Verifies iterating over operations in a graph returns the expected set.

methods.name: failImportOnInvalidGraphDefs
methods.description: Checks that importGraphDef throws exceptions on null or invalid input.

methods.name: failOnUseAfterClose
methods.description: Ensures operations after closing a graph throw an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: addGradientsToGraph
methods.description: Tests addition of gradients to the graph and fetches their values.

methods.name: addGradientSumsToGraph
methods.description: Tests adding gradient sums to the graph and running them.

methods.name: addGradientsWithInitialValuesToGraph
methods.description: Tests power of initial gradient values during gradient computation.

methods.name: validateGradientsNames
methods.description: Checks that gradient operations are named with the correct prefix.

methods.name: buildWhileLoopSingleInput
methods.description: Constructs and tests a simple while loop in the graph with one input.

methods.name: buildWhileLoopMultipleInputs
methods.description: Constructs and tests a while loop with multiple inputs in the graph.
